coordinates: body frame of mjcf body 'object' (what PoseReader returns)
schema: grounding symbol table: independent interaction POINTS and semantic AXES; frames are composed downstream as frame(origin=<point>, axis=<axis>), matching the emission DSL. Axis -> frame +z, completed by Gram-Schmidt.

pour_axis.comment: spout direction derived from mesh geometry; auto-calibrated from mesh (calibrate_frames_from_mesh.py)

tilt_axis.comment: up_axis x pour_axis, positive tips spout down; auto-calibrated from mesh (calibrate_frames_from_mesh.py)

lateral_axis.comment: canonical frame: lateral = up_axis x front_axis (= tilt_axis)

comment_scale: points scaled by 0.75 with the mesh (sim/make_assets.sh); axes unchanged
